script: Stars do not really twinkle. Their light is bent by moving pockets of air in our atmosphere. Planets usually shine steadily because they look like tiny disks, not points. From space, astronauts see stars that hold perfectly still. That is one reason telescopes like Hubble were put into orbit. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
